structural_observations: Torah #113 is one of the very short Torahs in Likutay Moharan Vol. 1 — 8 lines only.

Its entire structure is narrative and causal (eitza): heavenly assembly → deceptive questioning → person's verdict → decree sealed. This is a pure cause-and-effect chain, not a web of bechina equivalences.
The Baal Shem Tov principle is transmitted as a teaching about the mechanics of Divine judgment, with story (David/Nathan) and Talmud (Berakhot 5a) as illustrations.
The practical guidance in line 6 (שֶׁיְּשַׁנֶּה וִישַׁלֵּשׁ — examine and re-examine before rendering a verdict) is the Torah's eitza-conclusion, not a bechina cluster.
This Torah would require a separate eitza-graph analysis to fully map its conceptual structure, but that falls outside the scope of package analysis (which is bechina-only per the framework).
No data entry work is needed for this Torah's bechina layer — there is genuinely nothing to add. The Torah simply does not operate in the bechina register.
